title: Use Lazur as your real estate appraisal report software assistant on your Mac
metaTitle: Lazur: Real estate appraisal report software assistant for Mac
description: Boost your appraisal workflow with Lazur. Use voice commands to manage reports, research comps, and handle administrative tasks on your Mac.
intro: Lazur is a voice assistant for your Mac that helps you handle the heavy lifting in your real estate appraisal report software. It lives in your Mac notch and waits for you to hold a key to answer questions, point at screen elements, or dictate your findings directly into your forms.
tldr: Lazur helps you manage administrative tasks like AMC portal updates by voice.
Use your voice to dictate field notes directly into appraisal software.
Ask Lazur to research comparable sales and summarize data while you work.
It works in any app, including Windows environments running via Parallels.
Your data stays on your Mac and is never used to train AI models.

blocks.text: Managing your appraisal workflow on Mac

Real estate appraisal report software often requires a Windows environment. If you run your business on a Mac, you likely use Parallels or similar virtualization software. Lazur works across these boundaries because it sees your screen and listens to your voice commands regardless of the app or virtual machine you are using. You do not need to install plugins inside your appraisal suite. Simply hold your shortcut key and ask for help.
Dictate field notes directly into your forms

Manual data entry is a major source of fatigue. You spend hours typing notes from field inspections into your appraisal forms. Hold the fn key on your Mac to dictate your notes instead. Lazur provides clean, formatted text directly at your cursor. Whether you are filling out a 1004 form or adding comments to a property description, your voice can save you significant time every day. Ensure you follow your firm's rules regarding client data privacy when using voice dictation.

Finding the right comps takes hours of browsing through MLS systems and public records. Lazur can assist with this research. Hold ⌥ ⌘ to ask about a specific property or market trend on your screen. Lazur uses its own browser extension to gather data from the web and returns a summary. You can then copy this information into your report. This keeps your focus on the analysis rather than the search process.

Appraisal Management Company portals are notorious for interrupting your flow. You have to log in, find the status field, and update it manually. If you are stuck on a page, ask Lazur where the status button is. Lazur will draw a circle around the correct input field. You can also ask it to remind you to check your portals at specific times during the day, keeping your administrative tasks from ballooning into hours of extra work.

items: Neglecting to back up field notes before starting the report.
Spending too much time on a single comp search without a clear deadline.
Manually typing repetitive descriptions that could be handled with snippets.
Losing focus by checking emails too frequently throughout the day.

blocks.text: As a professional appraiser, you must follow your employer's rules regarding client data. Lazur does not store your audio or screen content. Everything happens on your Mac. When you hold the shortcut key, Lazur looks at your screen or listens to your voice only for that moment. It does not learn from your reports or share your data with other users. Always verify your firm's policy on using external tools for report generation.

faq.question: Can Lazur run inside my Windows appraisal software?
faq.answer: Lazur runs on macOS. It does not install inside your Windows software. However, it can see your screen while you use Windows in Parallels. You can ask it questions about what is on your screen or dictate text into your Windows apps just as you would in any macOS app.

faq.question: Is my appraisal data safe with Lazur?
faq.answer: Yes. Lazur does not store your screen content or audio. It processes your request only while you hold the shortcut key. Your data is not used to train any AI models, which helps you maintain your professional confidentiality requirements.

faq.question: How do I use Lazur for dictation?
faq.answer: Hold the fn key on your keyboard. Speak clearly, and Lazur will type the text at your current cursor position in any application. It works well for long property descriptions or adding notes to your appraisal reports.
